chapter: Early life and New Orleans bands
title: Piron at Antoine's and Sidney Desvigne
summary: Piron played nightly at Antoine's; talk of Desvigne and the riverboat trips.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, when they played at Antoine's, did they have music regularly or just for a certain party? Nightly. Nightly. Every night? Piron played there nightly. Piron played there nightly. Right in the main dining room. Yes, ma'am.
Gee, I never knew they had music. You all played on the JS Sydney a while too, didn't you?
No. The captain. I didn't go with Sydney a Vene, but Sydney a Vene left me was playing with me at the Hunt.
No, I mean, they both leave that Canal Street going to Resilient.
No. Uh-uh. I made one trip. Oh.
I mean, there was a hide there.

I remember Piron, I saw that job. Piron, yeah. Red Sydney, you remember Sydney? Yeah, yeah. We used to laugh at Sydney. He used to cut off. He used to cut off. Remember we used to laugh at him? Yeah, I remember.
